findings.desc: quality-cleanup: worktree-authority-smoke.ts:814 — assertion `existsSync(worktreePath) === false` is checked on line 808 (Step4 label) and again on line 814 (heartbeat label) in `assertDoneSuccessPathOutputAndOrdering`. Both run after the subprocess exits, evaluating the same boolean at the same instant; if writeLog recreated the dir the first assertion fails with the wrong message ("Step4 must remove..." instead of heartbeat). Mitigation: reorder so the heartbeat assertion runs first, or drop the duplicate and rely on the dedicated `assertPostDoneHeartbeatLandsInMainAfterWorktreeRemoval` test for the heartbeat-specific regression.
